tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search curated open-weight model release records by model name, developer, license, parameter or context description, and technical features. Returns canonical NLP.COM.AI pages and primary sources.

tools.name: recent_models
tools.description: Return the newest curated open-weight model release records, optionally limited to releases on or after an ISO 8601 date.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Return the complete curated record for one model or model-family release, addressed by the slug returned from search_models or recent_models.
